errors: An OOMKilled reason confirms an OOM kill, but does not by itself prove the container exceeded its own memory limit; node-wide OOM can also cause it.
kubectl top pod reports recent memory usage, not peak usage; it can miss the spike that killed a container. Peak measurement requires historical metrics sampled frequently enough.
A failing sidecar or init container does not ordinarily cause the application container to receive SIGKILL; listing this as a generic SIGKILL cause is misleading.
